rule: Unsubscribe, manage preferences and view in browser as Klaviyo tags (URL-only *_link forms inside href); postal address via {{ organization.full_address }}
No lorem ipsum, TODO, example.com links, href="#", empty image src or leftover [[tokens]]
Offers, codes, prices, reviews, deadlines and stock claims come from the link, the assets or the brief only
Every color in the HTML comes from the supplied palette (or an approved derived tint listed in notes.md)
Balanced {% if %}/{% for %}; no *|TAG|* or %%tag%%; first_name always has |default
HTML under 102 KB (warn) and never over 200 KB (Gmail clipping)
Subject 30-45 characters target, warn over 50, fail over 60; preheader 100 max and never repeats the subject
Exactly one primary button (the cta block); every other destination is a text link
Every content image has descriptive alt, styled alt text and a bgcolor cell; headlines are live text
Buttons at least 48px tall and full width on phones
No single word alone on the last line of a heading, button, label or short paragraph at 680 and 375px (render.py)
At least 24px between stacked blocks; 28-32px above a primary button
No em or en dashes (raw or entity); straight quotes only
No !! or ?! anywhere; at most 2 exclamation points per email
Spam-trigger words only when a real offer backs them
One idea per email; 3 to 6 body blocks
Use proof blocks where the email is about trust (welcome, objection, cart 2), not in every email
First email of any recovery flow carries no discount
Body and small text at least 4.5:1; button text on accent at least 4.5:1
No SVG, absolute positioning, script, form, iframe or video tags
